title: Player buys / reviews a plan
description: Sign in, open your plan with $, see that no current or next plan exists, pick a 5-visit pack, purchase with cash, and close.

steps.title: Start at login
steps.body: This walkthrough uses the tutorial player account. Credentials are filled so you can focus on the Sign in control.

steps.title: Sign in
steps.body: Simulate signing in. The next frame shows the Players home after authentication.

steps.title: Players home
steps.body: You land on the roster. Player accounts do not see Admin tools — plan management is via the $ control.
steps.resultNote: Header shows your name and the $ plan shortcut.

steps.title: Open your plan
steps.body: The $ control opens your membership / plan overlay from anywhere in the app.

steps.title: No current plan
steps.body: The plan screen opens. Current plan shows None — this member does not have an active plan yet.

steps.title: No next plan — buy one
steps.body: Next plan is also None. Use the Purchase section below to buy a new plan.
steps.resultNote: Next plan empty; Purchase section is available.

steps.title: Open the plan list
steps.body: Open the Plan drop-down to see every club plan and its price.

steps.title: Plan choices
steps.body: The list shows Monthly membership, the 5-visit pack, and other club plans with prices.

steps.title: Select 5-visit pack
steps.body: Choose the 5-visit pack from the list. Details and price update under the control.

steps.title: 5-visit pack selected
steps.body: The 5-visit pack is selected. Choose Cash or Pay online, then purchase.
steps.resultNote: Visit pack selected in the Plan control.

steps.title: Purchase with cash
steps.body: Tap Purchase · Cash. If you have an email and consent to online payment, Pay online would be the default instead. An administrator will accept the cash payment later — it moves from Pending to Paid.

steps.title: Payment pending
steps.body: Cash purchase is recorded as pending. An administrator clears it at the front desk; the payment then goes from Pending to Paid.
steps.resultNote: Pending cash payment awaiting admin clearance.

steps.title: Close
steps.body: Close the overlay when you are done. You can reopen $ anytime to check status.

steps.title: Back on Players
steps.body: Closing returns you to the roster. The pending purchase stays with the club until an admin marks it Paid.
steps.resultNote: Overlay dismissed; roster is interactive again.
